programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 430- Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. Up first in the middle weight division Denis Ceausu faces Andrei Varga. In the open weight division with a huge weight differential Rodrigo Mineiro, kickboxing world champion takes on boxer Bogdan Bestea for a boxing versus kickboxing contest. Watch as Alex Leautaund of the Netherlands takes on Romania's Mihai Desrobitu in a cruiserweight boxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 433 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. First up, a Superfight in the welterweight division, Bogdan Floristean versus Ionel Balan. In the women's lightweight division Maria Nitescu takes on Andreea Cebuc to determine the Baddest Woman in Romania. Also on this episode in the open division Tibor Varga of Hungary steps into the ring with Romania's Bogdan Nastase in a David versus Goliath duel.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 437 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of boxing and kickboxing fights. In the welterweight division Vinicius Bereta takes on Valentin Mavrodin in a Brazil versus Romania bout. In the open weight division Tolea Ciumac steps into the ring with Valentin Lambagiu with 100 pounds and over 20 years difference between the two fighters for a David versus Goliath duel. In the main event, Portugal's Iuri Fernandes faces Romania's Bogdan Stoica, with a stunning 58 wins to his name, in the Heavyweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 456 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1 from Transylvania, Romania. Starting off with a superfight in the lightweight division, Bogdan Floristean faces Ionut Popa and in the middleweight division, Dominik Horvath takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga. Also stepping into the cage are Brazilian Rodrigo Mineiro and Romanian Florin Lambagiu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 458 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2 from Transylvania, Romania. In this episode Fernando Martin from Spain and Romania's Andrei Leustean face off in a super middleweight division bout. Next up the co-main event in the heavyweight division, Hungary's Sandor Kertesz takes on Romania's Bogan Stoica. In the main event USA's Omar Moreno steps into the ring with hometown favorite Andrei Ostravanu for a rematch in a supermiddleweight fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 468 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up in the light-heavyweight division, undefeated Paul Danci takes on Alex Andreescu. Next up undefeated Eric Bubuleandra versus Becali Bodescu face off in the cruiser-weight division. In a heavyweight bout Bogdan Besta steps into the ring with Vasile Corcodel who looks to remain undefeated against his significantly heavier opponent. The main event features a super-cruiserweight bout between Italy's Frank Kanate and Romania's Stean Latescu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 469 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up, a bout in the cruiserweight division with Madalin Mogos versus Sebastian Lutaniuc. Achilles Karapiperis and Calin Petrisor "The KO Hunter" step into the ring to face off in a middleweight division fight. In an open weight entertainment fight Justitiarul De Berceni makes his professional debut against veteran fighter Tolea Ciumac "The Tiberian Bear." In the co-main event Netherland's Chris Baya faces Romania's Florin Lambagiu in a supermiddleweight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 484 - Dynamite Fighting Show - Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Best of Dynamite Fighting Show part 1 from Romania. In the first bout Damian Johansen from the Netherlands versus Andrei "The Bone Crusher" Varga from Romania face off in the middleweight division. Next up, a Superfight in the Open Division, Spain's Vajtan Shanava faces Romania's Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi. Stepping into the ring next for a boxing match are Gilson DaSilva from Brazil versus Florin Cardos from Romania. Also on this card, two Romanian's battle it out as the younger Sebastian Lutaniuv takes on the more experienced Marius Munteanu with 22 KO's.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 10
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 10 features Giselle Moreira and Daiane Firmino from SFT Brazil, Chandra Engle and Rachel Dovidio from NAAFA. Plus you won't want to miss famous fighers Julie Malenfant taking on Sara McMann and Anna Barone facing Charmaine Tweet from Blackeye MMA.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 11
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 11 features SFT's Bianca Sattlemeyer who steps into the cage with Florencia Aleona Greco, Julia Polastri takes on Jessica Cunha and female fightes from Caged Fury Tecia Torres and Rebecca Gruitza take to the cage. Don't miss the featured fighters from Blackeye Barb Honchak versus Roxanne Modafferi.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 426 - KOK Fight Series Hamburg part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK Fight Series from Hamburg, Germany part 1. Watch as Sebastian Karaj and Andre Vincent take to the ring, each with only one loss. In a Lightweight matchup Turkish fighters Levent Welsch and Tayyip Kocak step into the ring and in a Light Heavyweight match Donavan Grootjes faces Marvin Steputtis in a Coracao versus Gremany bout. Also in this episode, Atilla Onur is matched up against Claas Riot in a heavyweight bout boxing rules with MMA gloves.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 427 - KOK Fight Series Hamburg part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK Fight Series from Hamburg, Germany part 2. This episode features a four man Welterweight World Grand Prix tournament with Kevin Langeveld (Netherlands) versus Ramin Amiri (Germany) and Valentin Knau (Germany) versus Ewans Witte (Germany) in the semi-finals. Also in this episode Mikhail Gencer of Turkey takes on Liang Lo of Germany in a Lightweight bout and Leon Machere takes to the ring with Cem TV in a boxing match between two social media influencers.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Also in this episode Conor McAlister and Kelsey Crossey face off in the catchweight division while Michael Swann and Cian Sweeney take to the cage.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 431- Clan Wars 51 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. In a bantamweight contest, Ronan Deegan faces Adrian Barrow and Kelsey Crossey is matched up agains Jason McCourtney for a catchweight bout. In the main event Hunter Azure and Amun Cosme clash in the cage for the Bantamweight Championship Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 374 - KOK 105 Riga Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings part 1 from Riga, Latvia. Matched up first in a kickboxing bout are Anton Podgoryi from Poland and Husanjon Otajonov from Latvia. Also in this episode Davit Faroiani faces Benas Sorochovas in a kickboxing lighweight division match, Romanian Nicola Ixari gets in the ring with Lithuanian Mantas Rimsa and in a heavyweight MMA contest Nicola Gobus and Kristaps Zutis take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 375 - KOK 105 Riga Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings part 2 from Riga, Latvia. Starting us off Jakub Kwasniewski and Eduard Mishin battle it out in kickboxing contest. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 376 - United Fight League (UFL) 4
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents United Fight League 4 from Arizona. In this episode Richard Mahan and Daniel Garcia meet in the cage for a Bantamweight Bout. Marcus Nash takes on Sherzod Khamrakulov making his pro debut and in a Featherweight bout, Jose Delgado (5-1) faces Alberto Romo (4-1). In the main event Hunter Azure and Amun Cosme clash in the cage for the Bantamweight Championship Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 377 - KOK 107 - Mega Fight Arena Istanbul
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 107 from Istanbul for a night of kickboxing from the Mega Fight Arena. Gudrat Nabataliyev, a world class karate fighter takes on the muchh younger Iraj Moradi, Egi Rozten steps in the ring with Serdar Sayik while Muchahit Sezer and Enes Tetik battle it out in the ring. Also on this card is Chico Kwasi versus Vedat Kahramanoglu with over 80 wins between the two fighters there is sure to be lots of action.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 378 - Shamrock FC 354
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 354 from Ameristar Casino. Up first is Garren Lucas verus Eric Carrera while Gabe Stein and Joseph Murphy face off. Kody McGehee and Ernest Bolt battle it out for the lightweight title and in the main event Darian Weeks faces Max Choriev in a match between two UFC veterans.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 5
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 5 features XFN's Sarah Brewster facing Amanda Dieguez, Shamrock FC's Tabitha Trevino and Katelyn Radtka, SFT's Ruth Ravena taking on Edna Silva plus Nagila Goku facing Mel Alves. programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes - UFA's Baddest Babes 6

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 457 - Shamrock FC 368

In the co-main event, Max Choriev looking to head to the UFC faces Anders Murray in what's expected to be a battle of attrition and Sam Paneitz, coming off haitus, takes on Dusty Little.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 454 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In the main event, with the UNF welterweight title on the line Anthony Desimon looks to take the belt from Christopher London.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 460 - Up Next Fighting 14 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 14 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California with a night of great action. In the main event it's champion versus champion as Interim Lightweight champion Izac Enriquez takes on the returning champ Jairee Baker.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 461 - CMH Boxing II part 1

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. UWC continues to grow and to bring the fight fans across Europe the fights they want to see.

programme.desc: Chris Smeltzer's journey into MMA began 12 years ago, through Karate. Chris' work as a School Bus driver fits perfectly with his MMA lifestyle, allowing him the flexibility to train throughout the day, as well run a karate school for kids. The martial artist lifestyle helped bring structure to all areas of Chris' life. He believes he has become a better person through Martial Arts, and he makes the mental distinction between between being a fighter and being Martial Artist. He prefers the standup game feels he is progressing well to being an all around fighter with his BJJ Blue Belt.

programme.title: ADCC - Denver Opens
programme.desc: The Opens make their way to the mile high city where the best martial arts from the US look to stake their claim for supremacy as the circuit heats up. In this heart-pounding instalment, we bring you all the action from the epic showdown held in the magnificent city of Denver. Former UFC Strawweight Champion of the World Rose Namajunas known for her exceptional martial arts abilities, Rose is now ready to put her skills to the ultimate test in the realm of grappling. Witness her transition from the cage to the mats, as she grapples her way through some of the most intense matches of her career. ADCC Opens superstar and prodigy 16-year-old phenom, Helena Craver, steps onto the mats to showcase her unparalleled talent. With her sights set on glory, she aims to conquer the teenage, adults, and absolute divisions a feat that has never been done before. In a clash of titans, long time elite grappler Ryan Aitkens, a formidable competitor in his own right, is set to go head-to-head against the multiple-time world champion, Mateus Lutes. Brace yourself for an explosive battle between these two grappling juggernauts, as they leave everything on the mats in pursuit of victory.

programme.title: 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu - 20 Years in Orbit

programme.title: American Grappling Podcast- Ft. Dr. Ivan Rascon Aguilar
programme.desc: In this Episode of the AGF Podcast, Brandon Quick interviews Gastroenterologist Ivan Rascon - Aguilar, MD about the health benefits of the Carnivore Diet, how its changed Brandon’s life and how Dr. Rascon - Aguilar is helping hundreds reverse preventable diseases and how a dietary and lifestyle change can improve wellness and athletic performance. Keep an eye out for more American Grappling Federation content here on The Grappling Network.

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Grapplers Quest West Coast
programme.desc: Grapplers Quest was founded in 1996 and began the submission grappling fever throughout the martial arts world and set Grapplers Quest as the premiere submission grappling event. Check out these old school No Gi matches featuring UFC Champion B.J. Penn taking on Mike Cardoso- ADCC U.S. Trials Champion. Pioneering athletes like Marc Laimon, Dean Lister, Jeff ""Snowman"" Monson, Chris Brennan, Tony Desouza, Alexandre Dantas, Homer Moore, Alberto Crane, J.D. Penn, Garth Taylor and Sean Spangler. Don't miss the event that started a legacy in the sport of submission grappling and revoltionized ground fighting in the martial arts world."

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Grappling All-Stars
programme.desc: Grappling All Stars is a collection of the world's best grapplers in action on the mat from the OTM archives. Featuring; Renner Gracie, BJ Penn, Diego Sanchez, Jeff Glover, Dean Lister, and many more!

programme.title: BJJ Classics - Submissions 101 Chapter 2
programme.desc: Submissions 101 Chapter 2 features the top grapplers showing you their best setups and submissions. A new feature in this sequel includes submissions broken down into categories which include: arm attacks, chokes, leg attacks, triangles, and other attacks. These old school matches are a great learning tool for anyone beginning their submission training or advanced grapplers looking to add new tools to their game. 101 Submissions Chapter 2 includes over 1 year of competition footage from around the world compressed into 48 minutes of intense action from the greatest events in the globe.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 6

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 7

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 8
programme.desc: This Episode breaks down the double buggy choke from 10pQ 19, Geo Martinez's twister, Genki Sudo's flying triangle, and Tarik Hopstock's Tarikoplata.

programme.title: BJJ Trickster Episode 9
programme.desc: This episode breaks down Keenan Cornelius' Reverse Omoplata, Craig Jones' Inside Sankaku, Lachlan Giles' heel hook attacks and Grace “The Silent Assassin” Gundrum.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike delivers nonstop action with the world’s top riders. Watch Rachel Atherton, downhill champion, tear through Arrowhead, CA, Aaron Gwin, gravity master, and Steve Storey, trail innovator, dominate Trail Boik Time. Join Remy Metailler, freestyle phenom, in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, and see Gee Atherton, enduro legend, and Dan Atherton, mountain bike pioneer, push speed, skill, and style to the max.

programme.title: S1E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you inside the world of pro cycling and mountain biking. Follow Peter Sagan, multi-time World Champion, as his story unfolds, watch Loic Bruni, downhill superstar, conquer thrilling courses, and join Geoff Gulevich, trail master, as he charges through British Columbia’s most scenic and technical singletrack in an all-out Trail Party. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every ride.

programme.title: S1E3 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, and Nicholi Rogatkin, freestyle powerhouse, tackle the Downhill Challenge Medellín, the longest urban downhill race, with #HyperSmooth. Then join Gee, Rachel, and Dan Atherton, enduro and downhill champions, as they ride together through heart-pounding terrain. Speed, skill, and adrenaline collide in every unforgettable moment.

programme.title: S2E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike brings you the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch Sam Reynolds, street shredder, Clemens Kaudela, slopestyle champion, Theo Erlangsen, trail innovator, and Vincent Tupin, downhill powerhouse, in an exhilarating GoPro Course Preview in South Africa. Then head to Zion, Utah for Red Bull Rampage with Jaxson Riddle, big-air phenom, Reed Boggs, freeride master, Thomas Genon, slopestyle superstar, and Tom Van Steenbergen, trail blazing pro, as they push the limits of skill and courage on some of the planet’s most extreme terrain.

programme.title: S2E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on epic rides around the world. Watch Olympic gold medalist Conor Fields, BMX champion, compete at the highest level, then join GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, Geoff Gulevich, trail expert, and Sam Reynolds, street shredder, as they explore the stunning landscapes and dramatic terrain of Cappadocia, Turkey. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every breathtaking moment.

programme.desc: Join “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson and a fearless team of conservationists on an epic mission to protect the planet’s most majestic and endangered predators. From rescuing lions at the Kevin Richardson Wildlife Sanctuary in South Africa to safeguarding orangutans and Cape Griffons in the wilds of Indonesia, witness heart-pounding rescues, fierce battles against exploitation, and inspiring stories of survival. This is conservation at its most daring—unmissable, unforgettable, and truly wild.

It’s the ultimate fusion of wildlife wonder and high-octane thrills—you won’t be able to look away.

High-octane action, world-class talent, and breathtaking moments—you won’t want to miss a second.

programme.desc: Ian Hodgkinson, known as Vampiro in the world of wrestling, was a famed wrestler in the late 80’s and 90’s. Hodgkinson intimately peels back the curtain on the mysteries of this show, how it’s produced, and what life is like on and off the stage. We dive deep in to the lives of two wrestlers and follow their stories as they prep for their next fight: El Hijo Del Fantasma, an up and coming star who seemingly has it all, as well as Faby Apache, a veteran female wrestler struggling to stay relevant as she raises her son.

Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline. From 25 to 30 October, the world’s top kiteboarders will take to Fahid Island’s pristine waters in a six-day spectacle of high-flying action, part of the Fahid Island Watersports Festival – a nine-day celebration that will also feature the season finale of the GWA Wingfoil World Tour and the championship deciders of the SFT Surf Foil World Tour. In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing. New Zealand’s Hugo Wigglesworth, 18, heads the rankings after he burst on to the scene and dominated the opening stop of the season in Sylt, Germany, in August. But Finn Flügel, of Germany, who sits second overall, vowed that he would be back in Abu Dhabi, gunning for the title in what are likely to be similar, lighter breezes of the Gulf.

programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline. From 25 to 30 October, the world’s top kiteboarders will take to Fahid Island’s pristine waters in a six-day spectacle of high-flying action, part of the Fahid Island Watersports Festival – a nine-day celebration that will also feature the season finale of the GWA Wingfoil World Tour and the championship deciders of the SFT Surf Foil World Tour. In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing. New Zealand’s Hugo Wigglesworth, 18, heads the rankings after he burst on to the scene and dominated the opening stop of the season in Sylt, Germany, in August. But Finn Flügel, of Germany, who sits second overall, vowed that he would be back in Abu Dhabi, gunning for the title in what are likely to be similar, lighter breezes of the Gulf.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 3
programme.desc: Starting this episode, we are visiting Oman for the IODA Asia & Oceania Championship 2025, a leading youth sailing event that attracts hundreds of participants each year. We move on with an unmissable event that will take place in Palma, from March 27 to April 4. The 55th Trofeo Princesa Sofia Mallorca by FERGUS Hotels, as the first scoring event for the 2026 Sailing Grand Slam. Sailing Grand Slam, developed in close collaboration with World Sailing, is an international series of elite Olympic watersport events, uniting all 10 Olympic disciplines –across sailing, windsurfing and kiteboarding– into one integrated Grand Prix-style circuit in Europe and the United States. Following the event in Palma, the next event is Semaine Olympique Française in Hyeres.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: Changing Channels

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners

Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

(Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel battent les favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Célia Périllat-Pessey, au terme d’une étape qu’elles ont dominée de la tête et des jambes.Snow arrived in the Beaufortain resort for this fourth and final stage of the Pierra Menta. Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel defeated favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret and Célia Périllat-Pessey, at the end of a stage they dominated from start to finish.

programme.desc: two select runners comment on their participation in the Florence marathon and the organizers provide unique insights on the Florence marathon.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Zurich Barcelona Marathon 2026 Eng

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
programme.desc: The HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB is the final of four UTMB World Series majors in 2025, offering athletes a great opportunity to progress towards the UTMB World Series Finals. Celebrating its 6th edition with new and improved courses along with an even deeper connection to Thailands natural and cultural heritage, the event attracts over 7,200 participants, including 56 from the Asia region and an exceptional elite field across all distances.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 3
programme.desc: We start this episode from the United Arab Emirates and the 25th edition of Dubai Marathon. We then stay in Dubai for a very unique and fascinating event, the UAE SWAT Challenge. The next stop on our journey is Spain. The Mallorca 312 OK Mobility, one of the most significant cycling events in the region, returns on 25 April 2026 for its 16th edition. From Mallorca, we then move to southern Spain. Andalusia has captivated hundreds of cyclists over the past decade as the host of the prestigious Andalucía Bike Race. We then head to Turin, Italy, for the 2026 Turin Foil Grand Prix. This annual fencing tournament, organized by the International Fencing Federation, brings together elite competitors in both the mens and womens foil disciplines.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 4 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 4.

programme.title: Spartan Beast World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Spartan is back again to the culturally rich and visually intoxicating dunes of Abu Dhabi, UAE for the 2025 Spartan World Championship hosted by Abu Dhabi Sports Council. The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south – a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through 692 Untamed kilometres of unspoilt scenery and up 15 900m of climbing. The Absa Cape Epic is classed as UCI Mountain Bike Marathon Series (SSR) by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI); this official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racers calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best.

programme.title: Mediterranean Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Epic offers an UCI 4 stage race where mountain bikers enjoy mountain biking to the fullest during the route around Oropesa del Mar, in the Castellón province in Spain. From 05th to 08th of February 2026 the race leads through spectacular Mediterranean mild weather and routes with a perfect combination of sea and mountain!

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: The First Second - Jerome Clementz
programme.desc: Seeing Jérôme Clementzs eyes fixed on the track, we have already understood what dose of concentration, determination and pure strength he will unleash on the descent. Leaving, throughout his 20-year competitive career, little luck to his competitors, how does he oush the boundaries?

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 2
programme.desc: We will start this episode from Malaysia, where the 22nd Royal Langkawi International Regatta took place in January. We will continue with the WingFoil discipline.The previous WingFoil Racing World Cup season ended in Brazil, followed by a two-month break before the new season began. Before seeing what happened in the first event of 2026, let’s have a look at both the Formula Wing European and World Championships. The Formula Wing World Championships, taking place in Cagliari in the south of Sardinia, attracted 93 riders from 22 different nations of the most important event of the 2025 season. After a two-month break, the world’s elite WingFoil riders returned to the water as the 2026 WingFoil Racing World Cup season began. The first event of the season was a historic one. For the very first time, a World Cup series event was hosted in Hong Kong, China.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.4
programme.desc: La neige s’est invitée dans la station du Beaufortain en cette 4ᵉ et ultime étape de la Pierra Menta. Malgré des conditions météo difficiles, des milliers de spectateurs ont porté les enfants du pays, William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet, dans un ultime duel face à Samuel Équy et Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel battent les favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Célia Périllat-Pessey, au terme d’une étape qu’elles ont dominée de la tête et des jambes.Snow arrived in the Beaufortain resort for this fourth and final stage of the Pierra Menta. Despite the challenging weather conditions, thousands of spectators cheered on local favorites William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet in a final duel against Samuel Équy and Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel defeated favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret and Célia Périllat-Pessey, at the end of a stage they dominated from start to finish.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.3
programme.desc: Au terme d’une 3e étape champagne, les coureurs de la 40e pierra menta ont régalé les centaines de spectateurs montés au sommet du Grand Mont. Le général est bouleversé par la performance d’Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet résistent et confirment leur statut de favoris. At the end of a thrilling third stage, the runners of the 40th Pierra Menta delighted the hundreds of spectators who had climbed to the summit of Grand Mont. The overall standings were shaken up by the performances of Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet held their own and confirmed their status as favorites.

programme.title: The First Second - Sam Anthamatten
programme.desc: A specialist in high mountains, Sam is a committed freerider, but behind his instinct to ski, there is a guide: it is his job, his culture. At each line, an internal struggle begins between security and risk-taking ... The balance is difficult, with great freedom involved. Through his practice, he lives and perpetuates a mythical image, that of the Zermatt guide.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2026
programme.desc: Depuis 11 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 11 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.1
programme.desc: La 40e édition de la Pierra Menta, qui compte également pour le championnat du monde longue distance (ISMF), a démarré sur les chapeaux de roue, animée par les duels franco- français attendus. The 40th edition of the Pierra Menta, which also counts towards the ISMF long-distance world championship, got off to a flying start, enlivened by the expected Franco-French duels.

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.2
programme.desc: Soleil généreux et neige fraîche ont servi de décor au nouvel épisode sportif qui s’est joué sur les pentes du Beaufortain, lors de cette 2e étape sur 4. Generous sunshine and fresh snow provided the backdrop for the new sporting episode which took place on the slopes of Beaufortain, during this 2nd stage out of 4.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2026
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers. Fans from across the globe have the opportunity to witness the future of freeskiing unfold in real-time.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: 56th Engadin Skimarathon
programme.desc: On the second Sunday morning of March, the starting pistol for the Engadin Skimarathon was fired in Maloja in the Upper Engadin. It is the second largest cross-country skiing event in the world and the largest cross-country skiing event in Switzerland. Among the large crowd of participants are also world-class runners.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Ultra Gobi 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Each year, athletes from across the world gather in this remote wilderness og the Gobi desert for a test like no other. The 121-kilometer team challenge is where cooperation and strategy are everything, while the 121-kilometere solo adventure is a test for the braves. The legendary 400-kilometer race, a journey through solitude, extremes, and self-discovery. All together, they form one of the toughest endurance events on Earth.

programme.title: Zurich Barcelona Marathon 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Welcome to the 47th edition of the Zurich Barcelona Marathon, this 2026 edition gathers not less than 32,000 entries with the field made-up of 60 international visitors from 100 different nationalities.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards

In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 3
programme.desc: We start this episode from the United Arab Emirates and the 25th edition of Dubai Marathon. We then stay in Dubai for a very unique and fascinating event, the UAE SWAT Challenge. The next stop on our journey is Spain. The Mallorca 312 OK Mobility, one of the most significant cycling events in the region, returns on 25 April 2026 for its 16th edition. From Mallorca, we then move to southern Spain. Andalusia has captivated hundreds of cyclists over the past decade as the host of the prestigious Andalucía Bike Race. We then head to Turin, Italy, for the 2026 Turin Foil Grand Prix. This annual fencing tournament, organized by the International Fencing Federation, brings together elite competitors in both the mens and womens foil disciplines.

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south – a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Cycling For Autism Eng
programme.desc: Whether it was a need for adventure or to stop a life thats going too fast or to reconnect with the essentials, Adrien did a 6-month cycling tour of Europe in 2022. To make the adventure even more beautiful and intense to experience, it was natural for him to associate it with an important cause, and one that is close to his heart : Autism. Xavier is his 15 year old autistic nephew, and as he loves cycling as much as him, Adrien wanted to help the association “Des Rêves pour Xavier” (Dreams for Xavier) to finance an electric tandem. Adrien’s other goal was to raise autism awareness among as many people as possible.

programme.title: Tour de la Provence 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Since its creation in 2016, the CIC Tour de La Provence has established itself as a key stage on the cycling calendar, offering top riders ideal training grounds for the Tour de France. Between demanding climbs and iconic landscapes, the race tests punchers, climbers, and sprinters, attracting a high-level field each year. More than just a competition, it embodies the popular spirit of cycling and benefits from the support of a passionate region, making each edition an unmissable event of the season.

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Mediterranean Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Epic offers an UCI 4 stage race where mountain bikers enjoy mountain biking to the fullest during the route around Oropesa del Mar, in the Castellón province in Spain. From 05th to 08th of February 2026 the race leads through spectacular Mediterranean mild weather and routes with a perfect combination of sea and mountain!

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Absa Cape Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Absa Cape Epic is the world’s premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through 692 Untamed kilometres of unspoilt scenery and up 15 900m of climbing. The Absa Cape Epic is classed as UCI Mountain Bike Marathon Series (SSR) by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI); this official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racers calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

The Formula Wing World Championships, taking place in Cagliari in the south of Sardinia, attracted 93 riders from 22 different nations of the most important event of the 2025 season. After a two-month break, the world’s elite WingFoil riders returned to the water as the 2026 WingFoil Racing World Cup season began. The first event of the season was a historic one. For the very first time, a World Cup series event was hosted in Hong Kong, China.

It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.
